dom.text: Bogardan is the place where Jhoira finds the raised wreck of the Weatherlight on a beach, and where Tiana, moved by its skeleton, revives the inert Powerstone.
Jhoira asks Tiana to oversee the reconstruction while she gathers a crew, and the Weatherlight is restored and ready to launch, as the vampire Arvad swears to serve Jhoira.
A vampire knight of Benalia, Arvad says his compulsion lessened the night the Powerstone woke, and under its influence he loses his sensitivity to sunlight.
When a giant burning phoenix swoops on the camp, Arvad's arrows knock it off course and Tiana, empowered by Serra, drives her sword into it and pushes it into the sea.
